projects.title: Payroll & Billing Module
projects.summary: Multi-tier approval flows, payrun creation, and tax handling — without the spreadsheet headache.
projects.quote: Closing a payrun used to take days. Now it's a checklist.
projects.body:
## What was broken
Payroll teams juggled approvals, compensation reports, and tax handling across disconnected screens and offline spreadsheets. Every payrun close was a fire drill.

## What I changed
Designed multi-tier approval flows, payrun creation, compensation reports, and tax handling as one coherent module — built on design tokens so every state, table, and form stays consistent.

## Results
Targeted 20–30% faster payrun close cycle, with report generation success above 99%.

## Learnings
In enterprise UX, trust is the feature. Every ambiguous state you remove buys back hours of double-checking.

projects.title: Employee Data Management
projects.summary: Profile UX for ~150 configurable fields that doesn't feel like a tax form.
projects.quote: 150 fields, and it somehow doesn't feel like 150 fields.
projects.body:
## What was broken
Employee profiles carried ~150 configurable fields with role-based access rules — and the old UX exposed all of it at once.

## What I changed
A tab-fieldset architecture that groups fields by job-to-be-done, role-based visibility so people only see what they own, and drag-and-drop document handling.

## Results
Roughly 20% complexity reduction and 15–20% faster profile completion.

## Learnings
Information architecture is the design. The visuals only work because the structure underneath makes sense.

projects.title: BeeForce Assistant
projects.summary: An AI-powered conversational assistant for contract workers — onboarding, attendance, and payouts in chat.
projects.quote: I just ask it when I get paid. It tells me.
projects.body:
## What was broken
Contract workers had no easy way to check onboarding status, attendance, or payouts — every question became a support ticket.

## What I changed
Designed a mobile-first conversational assistant that handles onboarding, attendance, and payout queries — with clear AI affordances, graceful fallbacks, and language that meets workers where they are.

## Results
Targeting 30% adoption with measurably fewer support escalations.

## Learnings
Conversational UI isn't about chat bubbles — it's about designing every way the conversation can go wrong.

projects.title: BlueTree Company Website
projects.summary: Conceived, designed, and launched BlueTree's web presence — and keep evolving it.
projects.quote: The website finally looks like the company we're building.
projects.body:
## The work
Conceived, designed, and launched BlueTree's new company website from scratch — brand direction, layout system, and content structure — and continue to evolve it through ongoing redesigns to keep brand and messaging current.

## Beyond the site
The same system extends to exec-level design: pitch decks, investor materials, and customer-facing assets, all kept consistent through documented patterns.
